rules.heading: VILUPTABD OR LUPTA-SAMVATSAR

planetary.freeform: If Jupiter becomes retrograde and comes back to the former sign from which he became Atichaari, there is no Viluptabd, unless the total time of direct and retrograde movement equals one year.

rules.notes: Rules for determining when a year is considered Lupta-Samvatsar or Viluptabd based on Jupiter's motion.

rules.heading: VAAR PRAVARTI (THE TIME AT WHICH A DAY BEGINS)

planetary.freeform: Calculated using the distance in yojanas of one's city from the Prime meridian line, adjusted by 15 ghatis and the Dinaardha.

rules.notes: Method to calculate the exact moment a weekday begins for a specific location relative to the Prime Meridian.
